content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Coach Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PAU Coach Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application form for PAU Coach Recruitment 2026 is 18 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for PAU Coach Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the PAU Coach Vacancy 2026 is Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Coach post at PAU?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, there are 0 vacancies available for the Coach post at Punjab Agricultural University. This indicates a very limited or specific recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Coach position at PAU?
faq.answer: The salary for the Coach position at PAU is Rs. 700/-, Rs. 500/-, or Rs. 400/- per day, depending on the specific terms of engagement. The general range is Rs. 400 - 700 Per Day.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Coach post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Diploma Holder in Sports Coaching from NSNIS, OR have participated at Senior National Level, OR be a position holder at All India Inter-University Level, OR a Certificate Course Holder in Sports Coaching, OR a position holder at Senior State level.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for PAU Coach Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for PAU Coach Recruitment 2026. The fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Nil.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for the PAU Coach post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Coach post under Punjab Agricultural University is Ludhiana, Punjab. Candidates should be prepared to work in this city.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of Punjab Agricultural University?
faq.answer: The official website for Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is https://pau.edu. All official notifications and updates will be available on this portal.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is the Coach position at PAU?
faq.answer: The Coach position at Punjab Agricultural University is a Contractual job type. This means the employment will be for a specific period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.answer: The notification for PAU Coach Recruitment 2026 was released on 11 August 2026. Interested candidates should refer to this date for the start of the application process.
